summary: @lyxa.ai/core routes application event bus through hardcoded author-controlled CloudAMQP broker
details: bootstrapCore() in dist/index.js invokes initEventBus with a hardcoded amqps:// URL containing embedded username and password for a CloudAMQP vhost (dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna). The broker URL is not exposed as a configuration option, so any application that calls the advertised bootstrap function joins the author-controlled message bus: events the installer's application publishes via publishEvent are delivered to that broker, and messages arriving on subscribed queues are dispatched into the installer's registered service handlers. This gives the operator of the hardcoded broker visibility into the installer's application event stream and the ability to inject payloads that are processed by handler methods inside the installer's process. The AMQP credential is also shipped in plaintext in the published tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
